reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering truffle products, flowers, fish, wood debris, rice, a combat ring, prepared vegetables, vinegar, and Void relationship items were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish, glossary and Void names, crop timing, milling behavior, combat effects, food terminology, relationship semantics, object gender, and flower descriptions; both found no remaining objective issue.

Truffle_Description.source: A gourmet type of mushroom with a unique taste.
Truffle_Description.translation: Un tip rafinat de ciupercă, cu un gust aparte.

Tulip_Description.source: The most popular spring flower. Has a very faint sweet smell.
Tulip_Description.translation: Cea mai populară floare de primăvară. Are un miros dulce foarte discret.

TulipBulb_Description.source: Plant in spring. Takes 6 days to produce a colorful flower. Assorted colors.
TulipBulb_Description.translation: Plantează-l primăvara. Are nevoie de 6 zile pentru a produce o floare colorată. Culori asortate.

Tuna_Description.source: A large fish that lives in the ocean.
Tuna_Description.translation: Un pește mare care trăiește în ocean.

Twig_Description.source: A broken branch. Chop with an axe to obtain wood.
Twig_Description.translation: O creangă ruptă. Taie-o cu toporul pentru a obține lemn.

UnmilledRice_Description.source: Rice in its rawest form. Run this through a mill to increase the value.
UnmilledRice_Description.translation: Orez în forma sa cea mai puțin prelucrată. Trece-l printr-o moară pentru a-i mări valoarea.

VampireRing_Description.source: Gain a little health every time you slay a monster.
VampireRing_Description.translation: Recapeți puțină sănătate de fiecare dată când ucizi un monstru.

Vinegar_Description.source: An aged fermented liquid used in many cooking recipes.
Vinegar_Description.translation: Un lichid fermentat și maturat, folosit în multe rețete culinare.

VoidEgg_Description.source: A jet-black egg with red flecks. It's warm to the touch.
VoidEgg_Description.translation: Un ou negru ca tăciunele, cu pete roșii. Este cald la atingere.

VoidGhostPendant_Description.source: It's symbolic to the shadow people. As a gift, it signifies the desire to move in together as friends.
VoidGhostPendant_Description.translation: Este un simbol pentru Oamenii Umbrei. Dăruit, semnifică dorința de a locui împreună ca prieteni.
